reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00411F20 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/humanplayer/00411F20-HumanPlayer_WireSlide.cpp at sha256 feb1ace4b32a08ee3795198e5e4a56738205d1c3e12a134c77597496c25cf796 (recorded implementation.signature: int HumanPlayer_WireSlide1_2(float* context)). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: HumanPlayer_WireSlide
retail_function.summary: Twenty-two blocks 0x411F20-0x4123xx: wire-slide state machine over the human_player fields (0x368 gate), AI_CombatTarget_21, Vehicle_DeployGear_10, WeaponType_RegisterType_2 x3, AI_* ordering/cover/vision calls, Mat33_ToEulerAngles, Vec3_Normalize, Human_ViewCam x2, HumanPlayer_UpdateAnimation_4, SoundSys_SetMasterVolume_7/SetFrequency_7, HumanPlayer_LoadParameters_6 and an indirect call.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 22 block(s)/33 edge(s) at 0x00411F20; radare2 recovers the identical 22 block(s)/33 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 60 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail's 33 call sites include Mat33_ToEulerAngles(0x004B3C50), Vec3_Normalize(0x004B3100), WeaponType_RegisterType_2 x3, Air_* pairs and Human_ViewCam x2. The candidate adds Sys_Atan2UndefinedInOrig and Sys_FreeMemory_11 (neither is a retail call at this address) and drops/changes several AI pair calls (e.g. AI_UpdateOrders_19/22, AI_SelectTarget_21/20, AI_TakeCover_20/22, Human_ViewCam one of two).

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The typed float* accesses cover the same 0x368-gated state block, but the added free/atan2 calls change the side-effect set and the candidate's call sequence is not the retail sequence.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Returns an int (the candidate's context-derived value); BN models int32_t — the shape is plausible but the side effects differ.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The fld/fmul/fcom/fchs sequences and the NaN handling via FCMP_UO are preserved in the candidate's expression form.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(float* arg1)" at 0x00411F20; radare2 recovers "fcn.00411f20 (int32_t arg_8h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00411F20 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int HumanPlayer_WireSlide1_2(float* context). The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
